prompt:
Use case: one game UI asset for a portrait fantasy match-3 RPG ("Gemwoven"): the avatar frame of Hiro, the young traveller (free starter), redrawn so its ring carries an experience gauge.
Reference image 1 is the current approved frame: keep its identity, palette, painted quality, proportions and ornaments (a small bronze compass-rose emblem on top, two small green leaf sprigs on the sides, a knotted green scarf ribbon with two short tails at the bottom; modest and earthy, no gems, no gold filigree).
Change only the ring itself: the ring is now an EXPERIENCE GAUGE TRACK. It is built from a thin aged bronze inner rim, a thin aged bronze outer rim, and between them one smooth, recessed, empty groove of even width all the way round, dark walnut-brown lacquer, plain with no pattern, no stars, no swirls, no gems and no highlights inside the groove. The groove is a perfect circle concentric with the round opening, and about the same total ring thickness as the reference.
Nothing may cross or overlap the groove: the compass emblem sits fully outside the outer rim at the top; the leaf sprigs grow outward from the outer rim; the bottom ornaments are gathered compactly at the bottom centre only, covering no more than the lowest quarter of the ring (from about seven o'clock to five o'clock); the groove is fully visible and clean from about seven o'clock, over the top, round to about five o'clock.
Style: painted hand-drawn fantasy game UI, the same rich illustration style as the reference, crisp clean edges, soft shading, no pixel art, no text, no letters, no numbers.
Layout: exactly one asset centred on a solid flat pure magenta #FF00FF background, generous magenta margin all round, every ornament completely inside the picture, nothing touching or cut by the edges. The round centre of the ring is empty and filled with the same pure magenta. No magenta or pink inside the artwork itself.

precheck.summary: The candidate matches the prompt: a flat pure magenta background, a single centred frame with an empty magenta centre, a compass emblem fully outside the outer rim, leaf sprigs growing outward from the rim, and the bottom scarf confined to the lower arc. The groove is plain dark brown and unobstructed, and no text or extra figures appear. Minor drift in the ring's oval proportions and tight bottom margin is stylistic, not a defect.
